overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the complaint that a quorum deliberated outside a meeting on a sign variance rested on speculation, and bias claims were referred to MCAD.

allegations.summary: Alleged a quorum deliberated outside a posted meeting about the sign variance between the March 27 and April 24 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Complainant has not presented evidence beyond speculation and conjecture sufficient to support an allegation that the Board deliberated outside of a meeting regarding the variance.

allegations.summary: Complainant raised bias and discrimination concerns about the handling of the variance request, which the AG said fall outside Open Meeting Law review.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent the complaint raises allegations of bias and discrimination, such allegations may be brought to the Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination.
